448	
449	**`response`** is where the envelope judgement lives: `envelope`
450	names the single root property the payload's useful content sits under, or is
451	`null` when the field returns the whole body. It must name a root property of
452	the operation's response shape — `reconcile` and lint both refuse one that
453	names nothing (`unknown-envelope`), because a typo would otherwise flatten
454	the field to a type with no fields. `graphos-factory-core selection draft`
455	proposes one per included operation from the inventory's response facts and
456	marks it `confirmed: false` — as it proposes each `links:` entry below;
457	while it is false, `reconcile` names it as still the tool's draft and lint warns (`response-envelope-unconfirmed`). An
458	operation with no `response` block at all falls back to the suggestion, and
459	`reconcile` says which one it used (`no-response-envelope`). An absent
460	`confirmed` means confirmed: a hand-written selection is the user's word.
461	
462	**`response.referenced_shape`** is a different judgement in the same block:
463	which branch of a two-branch success/error `oneOf`/`anyOf`
464	response is the actual payload, for a case the source document itself
465	leaves ambiguous. `inventory build` already writes the same key as a
466	*fact* when the source makes the branches distinguishable on its own (one
467	branch's shape also documented at an explicit non-2xx status, or both
468	branches pinning a shared boolean property to the opposite literal) — never
469	from a property's name alone. When `inventory.json` has no such fact for a
470	known two-branch response and a human or agent has reviewed the case,
471	recording the same key here (a `#/shapes/<Name>` pointer, the grammar
472	`shape_ref` already uses) resolves the finding without ever touching
473	`inventory.json`: `reconcile`'s `root_properties` and `scaffold`'s response
474	body both read the inventory fact first and fall back to this judgement
475	only when the fact is absent. Absent both, the response types as the
476	workspace's JSON scalar and the finding stays open — `scaffold` says so in
477	a note.
478	
479	**Field paths** are rooted at the response body and use a
480	`>`-separated grammar with `[]` after a list segment:
481	`incidents[]>incident_number` for an item field in a paginated list,
482	`incident>pending_actions` for a field under a single-object envelope,
483	`more` for a top-level field. An operation that returns the type shares
484	the exclusions of every other operation that returns it — write them on
485	each (YAML anchors keep them in one place); `graphos-factory-core reconcile` reports the
486	selection that says "all fields" while the connector maps fewer.
487	
488	**`overrides`** carry the engineer's intent. A key names a *span* of the
489	schema — an inventory operation key (its root field or fields), `type:<Name>`
490	(a type, enum, input, union or scalar with its doc and comments), `Query.<f>`
491	/ `Mutation.<f>` (a root field the inventory does not explain) or `header`
492	(everything before the first type). `graphos-factory-core reconcile` lists each
493	override's drift from the selection in its own section, never counts it as
494	work, and checks its assertions against the span's current text:
495	`contains` / `not_contains` (runs of whitespace compare equal), `matches`
496	(a regex), `tag`, `arg` / `no_arg` (root fields), `field` / `no_field`
497	(types). A failing assertion is not clean. An override with no assertions
498	is **pinned**: the span is compared byte-for-byte against `--baseline` and
499	the agent must not change it — lint warns, because a pin freezes the
500	operation forever; assertions are what let it keep evolving. `until` is
501	free text saying when to revisit; `expires` (YYYY-MM-DD) is checked, and an
502	expired override is reported and is not clean. `customized` (the old
503	list of fenced operations) is retired; reconcile and lint refuse it.
504	
505	**`links`** are the relationship fields the user chose to expose — a
506	property that carries another resource's id becomes a field on its host
507	type, resolved by that resource's GET-by-id operation through a
508	field-level `@connect` keyed by `$this` (no `@key`). One entry per
509	relationship, keyed by the inventory shape and the property's path:
510	
511	```yaml
512	links:
513	  - shape: Song                          # #/shapes/Song, the shape that carries the foreign key
514	    path: album_id                       # the property's path from the shape's root, wire names
515	    operation: "get:/albums/{album_id}"  # the by-id operation the field resolves through; must be included
516	    parameter: album_id                  # its trailing path parameter (wire name); defaults to the fact's
517	    field: album                         # the GraphQL field on the host type; camelCase
518	    include: true
519	    confirmed: false   # drafted by `graphos-factory-core selection draft`
520	```

523	`candidate_entity_link` fact (what the property matched); `field`,
524	`include`, `confirmed`, `reason` and `decision` (`D-0019` or `D-k7m2qx`) are the
